The Tauri production build and the NSIS/MSI installers still need one elevated Windows SDK install; until then no installer can be produced or hashed for the website.

Smart App Control (VerifiedAndReputablePolicyState=1) intermittently blocks freshly linked test executables with `An Application Control policy has blocked this file (os error 4551)`. Each target sometimes gains cloud reputation after a 30-75s delay; on some hashes it never flips within the retry window, which is why `cargo test -p sayl-app` as a whole is unreliable here and per-target runs are used.

The Tauri window was never launched in this environment, so the desktop UI is verified only by unit tests, `cargo check`, the vite build and source inspection — no real runtime journey, no screenshots.
Model identity attestation for status=passed reports is env-var based (SAYL_PRIMARY_*), not cryptographic, per docs/REPORT-CONTRACT.md:9.
